scenarios: Read back the three GitHub milestones and seven scoped implementation issues without exposing private runtime data.
Start frontend, backend, and PostgreSQL with Docker Compose from an empty database and verify Flyway applies exactly once.
Register through the UI, verify registration does not create a session, log in, load current user, expire and log out the session.
Reject missing or invalid CSRF state on protected mutations and return generic authentication errors.
Recreate containers while preserving the account in the named PostgreSQL volume.
